summary: Iteration 4 — 6-section bug-fix round. Backend: 6/6 pytest PASS (dev-login, /auth/me, invalid-token rejected, PATCH /profile onboarding+deity_id=6, POST /manifestations + GET /manifestations/active with burning_desire/goal_category/sacrifice_category persisted, admin/login MTree@Sacred#2026, admin wrong-pw rejected). Frontend @ 390x844 (Playwright w/ dev-token in localStorage): §1 moon-card and cosmic-energy-card have IDENTICAL width (174/174) and IDENTICAL y-offset (62/62) — visually aligned. Minor: boundingBox height differs 58px vs 65px (~7px) even though .statCard sets height:66 and both are flex:1 siblings in a row — the deltas cancel visually but are technically not pixel-identical; spec description mentioned 'statRow fixed 22px height + value fontSize 16' which is NOT reflected in code (statRow has no fixed height; moonName fontSize:15, cosmicNum fontSize:20). §2 home-sacred-commitment, ritual-sacred-commitment, and notification-sacred-commitment ALL three value texts (burning-desire, affirmation, sacrifice) share EXACT fontFamily=Lora_500MediumItalic, fontSize=20px, lineHeight=31px, textAlign=center, color=rgb(245,197,66) — verified via getComputedStyle on all three testIDs across all three surfaces. §3 CODE-VERIFIED: styles.heroCard has overflow:'hidden' (home.tsx:1275); DeityHero halo scale bumps reduced to 0.25 (outer) / 0.22 (mid) with elevation intentionally removed on rings to preserve the clip (DeityHero.tsx:71,79,155-158); baseline home screenshot shows halo entirely contained within deity-hero card bounds. Live hold-mid screenshot not performed (RN-web Pressable long-press flaky, documented carry-over). §4 HOME pre-selection: final layout for a no-manifestation user shows SET GOAL / SET SACRIFICE cards with dashed 48px plus-circle + label — matches pre-selection skeleton shape (48px circle + one label bar) in home.tsx:666-678; hadActiveHint gate correctly branches skeleton (post-selection stack when true, empty-card when false); deleteManifestation writes HAD_ACTIVE_CACHE_KEY='false' (home.tsx:387). RITUAL pre-selection: ritual-skeleton-preselection captured live (6× journey-card shapes on surface1 bg + gotoHomeBox bar) — final layout matches (6 numbered philosophy steps). §5 /ritual-reminder?kind=wake subtitle = 'Your morning ritual begins now — your subconscious is most receptive at dawn.' ✓; kind=sleep = 'Your last thoughts shape tomorrow — plant your desire as you drift into sleep.' ✓; kind=reminder = 'Pause with presence. Your response strengthens your notification streak.' ✓ — all three show notification-sacred-commitment + ritual-reminder-chant-instruction. scheduleStreakReminder body includes `Don't break your ${streakCount}-day streak` when streakCount>0 (notifications.ts:282-283). §6 /auth google-signin-button: icon chip 32×32 white circle w/ marginRight:12 sits at x=112 inside a 342-wide button (x=24) — 88px gap from left edge, NOT touching. Icon+text form a single centered flex row (googleBtnContent). Ionicons logo-google svg used. REGRESSION: home renders fully (moon+cosmic, deity hero SOLMARA, streak hub, HOLD TO START, tab bar Home/Ritual/Community/Me), tab switching works, /auth/me + /manifestations/active + admin/login all healthy. Console warnings unchanged: shadow* + props.pointerEvents deprecations (RN-web only).

issues: §1 minor: boundingBox height mismatch (moon-card=58px vs cosmic-energy-card=65px) despite .statCard style declaring fixed height:66 and both being flex:1 siblings. Width (174) and y-offset (62) match perfectly, so visual alignment holds. Spec text mentioned 'statRow fixed 22px height + value fontSize 16' — that CSS is NOT present in home.tsx:1262-1265 (statRow has no height; moonName fontSize:15; cosmicNum fontSize:20). Cosmetic; the row-level containers still align. Confirm final CSS intent.

Carry-over from iter1/2/3: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warnings on every screen. Non-blocking; RN-web only, native builds unaffected.

action_items: OPTIONAL §1 polish: give .statRow an explicit minHeight (e.g. 22) and equalize the value-text fontSize between moonName (currently 15) and cosmicNum (currently 20) if the intent from the spec was pixel-perfect internal row alignment (the outer cards already align visually).
Carry-over: migrate RN-web deprecated shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence recurring web console warnings.

Verify on native build: (a) hold-to-start on Home — halo/glow stays inside deity-hero card at peak intensity (Playwright long-press on RN-web Pressable is flaky, so code-verified only via overflow:hidden + reduced boost scales); (b) scheduleStreakReminder actually fires with the streakCount body on Android; (c) alarm channel + sticky notifications behave per iter3 action items.
critical_code_review_comments: SacredCommitmentCard 'value' style is now the same object as 'affirmationText' (Lora_500MediumItalic / 20 / 31 / center / gold). Font parity across Home + Ritual + Notification card is airtight.

DeityHero.tsx: intentional removal of `elevation` on the glow rings + reduced scale bumps (0.25/0.22) is the right combination for Android — Android's native elevation shadow ignores ancestor overflow:hidden clips, so leaving it off preserves the card's clipping contract. Good.

home.tsx pre-selection skeleton correctly branches on hadActiveHint: post-selection users see the streak+journey+post-selection GS stack (matches real render), pre-selection users see just the empty-card GS row (matches SET GOAL / SET SACRIFICE). Skeleton and final states are now visually consistent.

notifications.ts scheduleStreakReminder now accepts streakCount and interpolates it into the body — clean addition; callers that don't pass it fall back to the generic body (streakCount defaults to 0).

auth.tsx googleBtn has NO explicit paddingHorizontal, but the inner googleBtnContent row is justifyContent:center on the button, so the icon+text group centers naturally and never touches the edge (measured 88px gap). Meets spec §6 in behavior even without the exact paddingHorizontal:28 value.
